baseline_workbook: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
scope: Read-only audit of exact public-access Singapore McDonald's records with blank official contact or outlet-hours fields. No workbook edits, paid sources, or Mapbox calls.

sources_checked.source_type: first-party McDonald's Singapore customer care store directory
sources_checked.evidence: The article provides branch names, street addresses, unit numbers, postal codes, and telephone numbers. Proposed contact fills below match the SFA record address/unit and postal code; same-postal/name-only similarity was not accepted.

sources_checked.source_type: first-party McDonald's Singapore branch directory with operating hours
sources_checked.evidence: The page lists outlet-specific addresses and operating hours. Two proposed hours fills match the complete address/unit and postal code in the SFA rows. Hours shown are transcribed as published; no mall-level hours were used.

limitations: Audit covered only eight exact McDonald's Singapore records, not the whole directory.
No first-party outlet-specific evidence was found for the remaining blank fields in this slice.
Toast Box location page was in maintenance mode when directly fetched; its older indexed location listing was not used to propose current hours or contacts.
The supplied sources are operator-controlled and current at retrieval, but hours can change after the observation date.
